definitions.aiu_by_feature: AI units and gross $ by Copilot feature per account and week (source 22). AI units are consumption units, not billable dollars
definitions.cca: Copilot coding agent decision intelligence (source 20), per enterprise or organization owner and completed month. share = CCA PRs / PRs, penetration = CCA repos / repos, frequency = CCA active days / active days, rate = cube root of their product; stage is the source's band
definitions.cca_epi_lift: Engineering-productivity index lift by PR complexity tier: CCA EPI / non-CCA EPI - 1, ranked within a peer pool. Observational, not causal; withheld where the owner has no non-CCA comparison
definitions.cca_opportunities: Source guidance (source 21): expansion signal score and band (S >= 60, A >= 40, B >= 20, C >= 5, D below) for CCA owners, and new-logo readiness for owners without CCA. Not a recommendation from this dashboard
definitions.ccr: Copilot code review (source 19), per enterprise and month. coverage = PRs reviewed by Copilot / reviewed PRs. penetration and the adoption score are published as reported; the current month is month to date. Account and portfolio rollups recompute coverage from summed counts and never average percentiles, penetration or scores
definitions.ccr_lead_days: Median and percentile PR lead time in days for Copilot-reviewed vs all other PRs; labels are passed through from the source and are observational, not causal
